content.short: Bit2Me is a Spanish crypto platform for buying, storing, trading, spending, and transferring digital assets.
content.description: Bit2Me is a Spain based crypto platform that combines wallet services, trading, transfers, card products, and account tools across web and mobile apps. Its public materials describe products such as Bit2Me Pro for advanced trading, Bit2Me Pay for user to user transfers, and the Bit2Me Card for spending supported balances. In this TON listing, Bit2Me fits as a broad crypto service provider and access point for users who may buy, hold, or move Toncoin through a general platform rather than through a TON native protocol or wallet only product.
content.meta: Bit2Me provides wallet, trading, transfer, and card services that can also serve users looking for a general access point to TON.
